notes:
Part D omitted — this exercise forbade opening any reading. All answers drawn only from documented biography (Wikipedia; BBC; CBS/NBC/Fox/CNN news reporting; Billboard; Washington Post; Today; interviews with Howard Stern 2015, Larry King 1999, Billboard 2016, Jay Shetty 2024; Mary Gabriel's biography as cited in Interview magazine). No astrological source was consulted.

BIRTH DATA (A1-A3, B5): Born 16 Aug 1958 in Bay City, Michigan, in hospital — B5 'hospital' is well documented. A1 'certificate': the widely circulated clock time for her is attributed to her birth certificate, but I deliberately did NOT open astrological birth-data databases to verify the minute, so the provenance is reported at the level ordinary biography supports. A2 'to_5' follows from a certificate-recorded clock time (not a to-the-second reading). A3 'unknown' is honest rather than conservative-by-default: checking for a rectification would have meant reading astrological literature, which was forbidden.

HEALTH (A4-A8, A31, A34, A6): A4 'four_plus' — documented admissions: Lourdes's birth (Oct 1996), emergency caesarean for Rocco (Aug 2000, placenta praevia), the 16 Aug 2005 horse fall at Ashcombe (three cracked ribs, broken collarbone, broken hand; treated and released), knee surgery (Apr 2020), hip replacement (Nov 2020), and the June 2023 bacterial infection/sepsis with several days intubated in ICU. A5 'two_plus' — caesarean 2000, knee 2020, hip replacement 2020 (she called herself a 'bionic woman'). A6 'joints' only: cartilage loss in hip and knee, 14 Madame X shows cancelled 2019-20 for 'overwhelming pain'. The 2023 coccyx injury and the 2023 sepsis were acute, not recurring, so back_spine was not selected. A7 'average' and A8 'no' are genuinely undocumented — no childhood illness or near-death is on record and she was a cheerleader, straight-A student and trained dancer, but no positive source says 'robust', so the middle option was taken. A31 'brief' rests on one documented self-report ('a little depressed' after the 2018 Lisbon move) plus grief statements; she has never disclosed a diagnosis or treatment, so 'extended' would be unsourced. A34 'brief' = the 2023 ICU stay and short surgical admissions; no institutional confinement.

FAMILY (A9-A13, B4): Third of six children of Silvio 'Tony' Ciccone (engineer, Chrysler/General Dynamics) and Madonna Louise Fortin, so B4 'middle'. A12 'died_early': her mother died of breast cancer 1 Dec 1963, aged 30, when Madonna was five. A10 'conflicted': decades of documented resentment (father's 1966 remarriage to housekeeper Joan Gustafson, strict religious household, her 'I was really hard on her' and 'I wouldn't have turned out the way I was if I didn't have all those old-fashioned values to rebel against'), later reconciliation — he is still living, so 'died_early' and 'absent' are wrong and 'conflicted' best spans the record. A11 'steady': Tony Ciccone was the first in his family to attend college, held continuous engineering work and moved the family up into the Detroit suburbs — no documented reversal. A13 'lost': eldest brother Anthony (alcoholism, periods of homelessness under a Detroit bridge, publicly estranged) died Feb 2023; younger brother Christopher — estranged after his 2008 book 'Life with My Sister Madonna', reconciled before the end — died of cancer 4 Oct 2024. Stepmother Joan died Sept 2024. A9 'unknown': only Elsie Mae Fortin, her maternal grandmother (b. 19 June 1911, d. 2011 at 99), is documented; I found nothing dated on Willard Fortin or the paternal Ciccone grandparents from Pacentro, so an average would be invented.

EDUCATION (A14-A15): Rochester Adams High School, graduated a semester early in Jan 1976; dance scholarship to the University of Michigan, left in 1978 without a degree. A14 'school'; A15 'brief' — the university exit was a voluntary career decision, not a serious disruption, but it did leave the degree incomplete.

WORK AND MONEY (A16-A23): A16 own_business (Maverick, founded April 1992 with a $60m advance and 20% royalty; MDNA Skin; Hard Candy Fitness) plus professional_practice (self-directed recording/performing career). A18: design_art (music, dance, performance) and writing_media (songwriter; directed 'Filth and Wisdom' 2008 and 'W.E.' 2011; children's books) are core; textiles_luxury and trade_retail cover the Material Girl clothing line, fragrances and skincare; religious covers Raising Malawi (2006) and the Ray of Light Foundation (1998); astrology_occult is selected only for her documented ~29-year Kabbalah practice (Jewish mysticism), not for any horoscopic interest. A19 'about_right': seven Grammys, two Golden Globes, twenty VMAs, Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in her first year of eligibility, Songwriters Hall of Fame — she herself argues she has been underestimated, but the record does not support 'short'. A20 'most': essentially the entire fortune was earned away from Bay City, with tours grossing over $1.5bn worldwide. A21 'net_gain' refers to real estate and an art collection reported above $100m, not to betting or lottery — no gambling is documented, and Maverick was a partial loss when she exited in 2004. A22 'none' and A23 'none': no inheritance, windfall or debt trouble is documented (the 1978 poverty in New York was low income, not debt).

MARRIAGE AND CHILDREN (A24-A29): Sean Penn, married 16 Aug 1985 (her 27th birthday), divorce filed Dec 1987 and withdrawn, refiled 5 Jan 1989 after an alleged assault at Malibu, final Sept 1989. Guy Ritchie, married 22 Dec 2000 at Skibo Castle, divorced 2008. A24 'divorced' (unmarried since). A25 gives the first marriage year. A26 'on_time' — 27 is unremarkable; no family pattern is documented well enough to call it early or late. A28 'three_plus': six children — Lourdes Leon (14 Oct 1996, father Carlos Leon), Rocco Ritchie (11 Aug 2000), David Banda (adopted 2006), Mercy James (adopted 2009 after a lower-court refusal was overturned on appeal), and twins Stella and Estere (adopted 2017). A29 'no': placenta praevia complicated Rocco's birth but no infertility or loss of a child is documented; the adoptions were elective.

EVENTS (A35, B6): capped at 12. Omitted for space, all documented: the April 1992 Maverick deal, the 1992 'Sex' book and 'Erotica' backlash, the 1989 Pepsi 'Like a Prayer' boycott, Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction 2008, the 2015-16 transatlantic Rocco custody case, knee and hip surgeries in 2020, Anthony's death Feb 2023, Christopher's death Oct 2024, and the Celebration Tour (Oct 2023 - May 2024, ~$225m, including a free 1.6m-person Rio show). B6 'first_job' 1978 is her first paid employment in New York (Dunkin' Donuts, Russian Tea Room hatcheck, Terrace on the Park elevator operator); if the intended sense is career start, the Sire deal / 'Everybody' in Oct 1982 is the alternative. B6 has no father_death row: Tony Ciccone is still living.

A36 'better': the six years to mid-2023 held the Lisbon relocation, 14 cancelled Madame X shows, two surgeries, the pandemic and the near-fatal June 2023 sepsis; since then she recovered and completed the record-grossing Celebration Tour. Weighed against that are the deaths of Christopher and of her stepmother in late 2024, which is why this is 'better' and not 'much_better'.

PART C reasoning. C1 opt1 (clearly one way, difficult): both elder brothers, Anthony and Martin, are documented for alcohol problems and estrangement, and Anthony attacked her publicly in the press. C2 opt1: two divorces, one preceded by an assault allegation. C3 opt2: long-standing friendships (Debi Mazar, Rosie O'Donnell, Ingrid Casares, manager Guy Oseary) alongside documented ruptures (Sandra Bernhard, the long Elton John feud). C4 opt1 (both): her voice and her outspokenness built the career and repeatedly cost her — the 1994 Letterman profanity broadcast, the 2003 'American Life' video withdrawal, the 2017 Women's March remark that drew official attention. C5 opt1 (both): the music career is one of the most decorated in history while the acting career drew multiple Razzies including Worst Actress of the Century. C6 opt1 at confidence 2: no eye trouble is documented at all, so 'clearly one way' is chosen by absence of evidence, not by evidence. C7 opt1 (both): relentless effort produced enormous output and also the documented physical breakdowns of 2019-20. C8 opt2 (difficulty): money moved OUT through marriage — she was the wealthier party in both, and reporting on the Ritchie divorce describes a very large settlement paid by her. C9 opt2 at confidence 3: six children raised, but the 2015-16 custody fight over Rocco was a genuine public reversal. C10 opt2 confidence 5: New York, London and Lisbon made the entire career. C11 opt2 at confidence 2: no vehicle accident is documented (the 2005 and 2009 falls were from horses, not vehicles), so this is again absence of evidence. C12 opt2 (difficulty): by her own account in Billboard, losing her mother left her determined that 'I will control everything' — letting go is the documented weak point.

B2 'lean_short' is the least certain physical answer: she is about 5'4" and famously lean and muscular; 'medium' would also be arguable on height alone.
